title: 5.5.2 Slingshot — Worked Example
description: Drag a ball back from a fixed anchor, release, and watch it launch.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: A DistanceJoint tethers the ball to an anchor. On mouse drag, the ball follows the cursor; on release we remove the joint so the ball flies free.
hints: Removing the joint on release lets the ball fly.

steps.title: Tune the snap
steps.instructions: Try higher damping on the joint to make the tether snappier, or skip the joint entirely and set ball.vel directly based on drag distance.

steps.title: Add targets
steps.instructions: Stack more dynamic blocks and knock them over with the slingshot.
